The affix क्यङ् in the sense of exerting in the dishonesty, is employed after the word कष्ट 'mischief' when the latter has the 4th case-affix in construction.

Terms: क्यङ्

आम् is the affix of the verb कास् 'to cough' and of those roots that are formed by affixes i.e. the derivative verbs, when लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows, in the मन्त्र।

Terms: आम्

The same verb should be used after the gerunds formed from the verbs कष् 'to rub' etc. as the verb from which the gerund is derived.

Terms: णमुल्

The short इ is the substitute of the final अ of क when the affix is added.

Terms: इ

The affixes ठञ् and ञिठ् come in the remaining senses after the words काशि etc.

Terms: ठञ् and ञिठ्

The affix णिनि comes in the sense of 'enounced by him' after the words 1. काश्यप and 2. कौशिक denoting ऋषि-s (Vedic Seers).

Terms: णिनि

The letter द is the substitute of the final क् of an indeclinable when the affix अकच् (अक्) is added.

Terms:
The affix ष्टरच् (तर with feminine -- अन्यतो ङीष्

) comes in expressing diminution after the words 1. कासू and 2. गोणी।

Terms: ष्टरच्

The words कास्तर and अजस्तुन्द are names of cities.

Terms: word meaning

स् or ष् is substituted for the विसर्ग before a hard guttural or a labial in the words कस्क etc.

Terms: विसर्ग सन्धि
